en.headline:
Tasks, sorted by
what matters.
en.intro: See importance and urgency separately, then keep your tasks in four calm, color-coded spaces.
en.concept_title: Important and urgent are different questions.
en.concept: Important work supports something you care about. Urgent work needs attention soon. The board combines those two questions, giving each combination a gardening name. These are categories you choose, not stages a task must pass through.

plant: Make room for longer-term care, learning and relationships before they become a deadline.
harvest: Work with a real near-term consequence, such as preparing tomorrow’s presentation.
dry: Keep low-priority miscellaneous tasks visible without treating them as immediate demands.
thin: Separate time-sensitive routine requests from work that matters most to you.

en.reference: The urgency/importance distinction is explained in FranklinCovey’s Habit 3 overview. The gardening labels and board arrangement are this app’s own presentation.
en.demo_intro: For this example, decide where “Prepare tomorrow’s talk” belongs.
en.demo_note: An unsaved explainer using the app’s actual category definitions and icons. The full app lets you place tasks yourself; it does not judge their priority automatically.
en.features_title: A task stays the same when its priority changes.
features: Add a title to the inbox on the right. A due date is optional; the date shortcuts attach a date to the task. Check the displayed date before relying on a shortcut.
Use the task’s drag handle to move it to a category. Drag it back to the inbox when you want to leave its category undecided. The board uses compact markers; hover to see their titles and details.
Click the empty card background to open a larger list, add directly to that category and see its completion count. Category edits preserve the other categories and the inbox.
Use the task indicator to mark completion. In the full list, the delete control removes a task. Completed items remain visible until removed.
steps: Use the 添加新任务… field and 添加 button. Start with something specific enough to do.
Ask whether it matters to you and whether it needs attention soon. Drag the task into the corresponding card.
A deadline or your priorities may change. Move the task again, then mark it complete when finished.
captions: The released board, with its original category names and colors.
A real walkthrough using clearly labelled sample tasks.
The category’s expanded list and task controls.
en.limits_title: Dates are labels, not a reminder service.
en.limits: The app records due dates and highlights their status. It does not schedule notifications, repeat tasks every morning, or provide a calendar service. The clock and changing sky are part of the workspace’s atmosphere.
en.storage: Task records and category preferences are kept in this browser’s local storage. Another browser or app address has a separate copy. There is no account sync or built-in JSON backup in the current interface; clearing site data can remove the records.
en.location: The app may ask for location to look up sunrise and sunset times for the backdrop. The task board does not need that permission; the current code uses a default location when it is unavailable. This introduction never requests location.
en.run_note: Install dependencies and use the address printed by Next.js. The task flow needs no AI key or account; the sunrise/sunset lookup is a separate external request.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
分清轻重缓急，
再开始今天。
zh.intro: 分开看重要性与紧迫性，再把任务放进四个安静、清楚的分类空间。
zh.concept_title: 重要和紧急，是两个不同的问题。
zh.concept: 重要的事，关系到你在意的目标；紧急的事，需要尽快处理。应用用园艺中的四个名字表示这两种判断的组合。它们是你选择的分类，不是任务必须依次经历的阶段。

plant: 提前给长期的健康、学习与重要关系留出空间。
harvest: 处理有实际近期后果的工作，例如准备明天的演讲。
dry: 让低优先级的杂事有地方存放，不必都当作眼下的要求。
thin: 把需要及时处理的日常请求，与对自己更重要的事分开。

zh.reference: 紧迫性与重要性的区分，可参阅 FranklinCovey 的 Habit 3 介绍。园艺名称与卡片排列是这个应用自己的呈现方式。
zh.demo_intro: 以“准备明天的演讲”为例，想一想应该放在哪里。
zh.demo_note: 这是采用真实分类定义与图标的小演示，不保存内容。完整应用由你手动分类，不会自动判断任务的重要性。
zh.features_title: 优先级变了，任务本身还在。
features: 在右侧待办事项输入标题。截止日期是可选项，日期快捷按钮会给任务附上日期。 使用快捷日期后，请核对任务实际显示的日期。
使用任务的拖动手柄，把它移入分类。还没想好时，可以再拖回待办事项，暂时不分类。 面板中使用紧凑的任务标记，悬停可以看到标题与细节。
点击卡片空白背景，打开更大的列表，直接添加分类任务并查看完成数量。分类中的修改会保留其他分类与待办事项。
点击任务指示图标标记完成。在完整列表中，删除按钮会移除任务；已完成项目在删除前仍然保留。
steps: 在“添加新任务…”里输入内容，再点“添加”。从一件具体、可以执行的事情开始。
分别问自己它是否重要、是否需要尽快处理，再拖到对应的卡片中。
期限和优先级都可能变化。需要时再次移动任务，做完后标记完成。
captions: 已发布的四分类面板，保留原有名称与颜色。
使用明确标注的示例任务进行真实操作。
分类展开后的列表与任务控件。
zh.limits_title: 日期是任务标记，不是提醒服务。
zh.limits: 应用记录截止日期，并突出显示到期状态。当前界面不提供通知、每日重复任务或日历服务。时钟与随日光变化的天空背景属于工作区氛围。
zh.storage: 任务与分类偏好保存在当前浏览器的本地存储中。另一浏览器或应用地址拥有各自独立的记录。当前界面没有账号同步或内置 JSON 备份，清理网站数据可能移除这些记录。
zh.location: 应用可能请求位置，用于查询背景所需的日出日落时间。任务面板不需要这一权限；当前源码会在无法获取位置时使用默认地点。这个介绍页本身不会请求位置。
zh.run_note: 安装依赖后，打开 Next.js 打印的地址。任务流程不需要 AI key 或账号；日出日落查询是独立的外部请求。
zh.footer: 由 Songhai Fan 制作的 Frankie 系列项目
